items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: And the project included Marvin Stamm, my wonderful friend and great trumpet player. And Marvin and I were the featured soloists, along with soloists in the band on that project.

ctx.x: Yeah that’s “Sunday in New York” and it was part of a – I was commissioned to write a program that I decided we would call “New York State of Mind” for the WDR Big Band in Cologne. And it was about ten years ago. And we also did that program with the U.S. Air Force Airmen of Note. And the project included Marvin Stamm, my wonderful friend and great trumpet player. And Marvin and I were the featured soloists, along with soloists in the band on that project.
